decisions.reason: The 15-day express delivery program builds on the firm's existing production and logistics knowledge, and its early results are easy to interpret, so it is likely kept even if partly redundant with the broader express line.
The 72-hour express delivery program leverages the firm's fast-response logistics and spare-parts capabilities and serves as a clear differentiator, so it is likely retained.
This fire-resistant steel exterior door directly extends the firm's existing fire-door expertise and has European approval, indicating strong absorptive capacity and low drop risk.
The express delivery product line for doors and gates builds on the firm's core manufacturing and logistics knowledge and is featured on its own page, signaling continued investment.

The online ordering and digital services platform lies outside the firm's traditional manufacturing and service knowledge, making it hard to assimilate and improve, so it has the highest likelihood of being dropped.
The fire and smoke protection door is closely related to the firm's existing safety and fire-protection expertise, so the firm can interpret its results and likely keep it.
